settings.pockets: a tree ends below its first pocket (plan 13.22)
settings.fuel: each test's own fuel: heat of combustion and yields (plan 12.9)
settings.walls: each test's own surfaces from its FDS input, areal heat capacity matched over one cell; and their layers passed to the solver (--wall-layers)

series.steckler: NBS 1980 to 1981, Steckler, Quintiere, Rinkinen; small room doorway flows
series.nbs: NBS 1985, Peacock, Davis, Babrauskas; three-room suite with a corridor
series.nistnrc: NIST 2003, Hamins et al. for the US NRC; large compartment (shares NIST's large fire laboratory and lead with wtc)
series.wtc: NIST 2004, Hamins et al. for the WTC investigation; spray-burner compartment (shares the laboratory and lead with nistnrc)
series.atf: ATF Fire Research Laboratory 2008, Sheppard; two corridors joined by a stairwell (a federal laboratory other than NIST)
series.fsri: UL FSRI 2018, Willi et al.; gas burners in a 3.66 m room with one door (a laboratory other than NIST and ATF; a box scene, no FDS input)
series.ulnist: NIST at UL 2012, Opert; gas fires in a 6.1 x 4.3 m room with a door and ceiling vents, first interval (NIST's fire fighting group; UL's building)
series.fse: NIST 2008, Lock et al.; an ISO 9705 room, the tests with doors of 0.4 m or more, first window

settings.verdictRule: calibrated on a cell: at least three independent datasets each within this project's calibrated band (2026-11-08 plan, section 8, on the FDS Validation Guide's statistics: 0.8 <= delta <= 1.25, sigmaM <= 0.35) with none of their runs stopped, and the pooled pairs within that band too; indicative: pooled within 0.67 <= delta <= 1.5, sigmaM <= 0.5; otherwise not calibrated
settings.claimRule: claim protocol 2026-11-12, section 4: calibrated if in the calibrated band in >= 3 datasets and outside the indicative band in none; indicative if in the indicative band (or better) in >= 2; else not calibrated; a dataset with a stopped run counts as outside
settings.rule: claim protocol addendum 2026-11-12 00:28: a run whose fire's gas cannot reach the open boundary, though its test had an opening, is left out and reported as not represented on this grid (lib/represented.mjs; sealed by design: {"nistnrc":["01","02","07","08","13"],"nbs":["100O"]})
